fusions.name: Fixing Stare
fusions.desc: Stares down a narrow cone 6 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Vulnerable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Foregone Conclusion
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Opened Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Hidden
fusions.desc: Your arcane damage cannot be resisted.
